# USD/JPY close for Oct 4, 2026: research brief (as of 2026-09-20)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on the Yahoo Finance USDJPY=X daily close for 2026-10-04. That date is a Sunday, so under the fine print the **Friday 2026-10-02 close** will almost certainly be used. Yahoo FX daily bars normally cover weekdays only.
- 2026-09-20: I could not open the Yahoo history page because the proxy refused the connection. Several other pages (FXStreet, NordFX, MUFG) would not load either, so the figures below come from search-result summaries and are approximate. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/USDJPY=X/history/)
- 2026-09-18 (latest close before the cutoff): I could not find an exact close. Reports put the pair just above 157 after the Bank of Japan (BoJ) decision, so the week ended around 157. [MUFG JPY Weekly 24 Sep](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-24-september-2026/), [TradingEconomics](https://tradingeconomics.com/japan/currency/news/584917)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles the question. The spot rate of about 157 sits in the middle of the 145-165 range, and about two weeks of trading remain.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-18: The BoJ raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25%, the highest since 1995. The vote was 7-2, with Asada and Sato dissenting. The yen weakened anyway because Governor Ueda's comments were read as mixed or dovish and because markets expect Japan's tightening to lag the Fed's. USD/JPY went back above 157, a two-week high for the dollar. [Babypips](https://www.babypips.com/news/headline-boj-rate-hike-september-2026-yen-falls-dovish-ueda), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/18/japan-rate-hike-stocks-rise-bond-yields-yen-fall.html), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-18/yen-drops-against-dollar-after-boj-raises-rates-as-expected), [TMGM](https://www.tmgm.com/en-eu/analysis/market-news/article/japanese-yen-struggles-near-two-week-low-vs-usd-after-boj-governor-uedas-comments-202609180708)
- 2026-09-18: Before the BoJ decision, the pair rose to just under 156.50 after Japan's August CPI came in below expectations. [MUFG](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-24-september-2026/)
- 2026-09-16: The Fed raised rates 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on a 12-0 vote, its first hike since 2023, citing elevated inflation. USD/JPY quickly moved above 156. [Federal Reserve](https://federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260916a.htm), [MUFG](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-24-september-2026/)
- 2026-09-14: The week opened near its low of 153.41, and dollar buying pushed the pair above 155. [MUFG](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-24-september-2026/)
- 2026-09-08: RoboForex reported 154.11, which it called a six-month low, reached without any official intervention. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/usd-jpy-forecast-2026-09-08/)
- 2026-09-03: The yen jumped on bets of a BoJ hike and talk of intervention. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/03/yen-japan-intervention-boj.html)
- Early September: MUFG said the pair started the month near 160 and fell toward 155.50 by September 4. [MUFG JPY Weekly 7 Sep](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-7-september-2026/)
- 2026-08-07: The Japan Times reported that US support for the yen had raised expectations of a September BoJ hike. [Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/08/07/markets/boj-hike-september/)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Range so far in September 2026: about 153.4 to 160. The pair moved roughly 3.5 yen within the single week of Sept 14-18. [MUFG](https://www.mufgresearch.com/fx/jpy-weekly-24-september-2026/)
- Typical variation, my own rough estimate rather than a sourced figure: USD/JPY's implied volatility usually runs about 8-11% a year. Over 10 trading days that works out to a one-standard-deviation move of roughly 1.6-2.2%, or about ±2.5-3.5 yen from 157. On that basis, a close anywhere between about 151 and 163 would be unremarkable.
- Over the past two years, the 158-162 zone has repeatedly drawn intervention warnings from Japan's Ministry of Finance (MoF), and actual intervention occurred near 160-162 in 2024. That has tended to cap rallies.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi runs 15-minute and weekly USD/JPY markets (series KXUSDJPY15M and KXUSDJPYAW). I found no snapshot from on or before Sept 20 for a contract around Oct 2. [Kalshi weekly](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxusdjpyaw/usdjpy-weekly/kxusdjpyaw-26oct16), [Octagon tracker](https://www.octagonai.co/markets/topics/usdjpy-weekly/)
- Robinhood has listed date-specific USD/JPY prediction markets, for example one for Sept 7. I found nothing for early October. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/fx/events/us-dollar-to-japanese-yen-exchange-rate-september-7-2026-sep-07-2026/)
- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this question, and no bank point forecast dated before the cutoff for early October.

## 6. Upcoming events before Oct 2
- Sept 21-23: Japanese holidays (Respect for the Aged Day, the bridging citizens' holiday and the Autumnal Equinox). Thin Tokyo liquidity can make sharp moves, or intervention, more likely.
- Late September: US PCE inflation data and Fed speakers, as markets judge whether more Fed hikes will follow.
- Late September: Tokyo CPI, and the effective date of the BoJ hike (reported as Sept 24).
- Sept 30: US fiscal-year-end and government funding deadline, a possible shutdown risk that could delay data releases.
- Oct 1: BoJ Tankan survey, which matters for expectations of the next BoJ meeting (Oct 29-30).
- Oct 2: US September jobs report, released on the same day as the closing value that likely resolves the question.
- Any time: MoF or Finance Minister Katayama warnings, or actual intervention, if the pair approaches 158-160.
